subject.title: feat: expose readable session presentation metadata

question: Should `sessions.list.presentation.family` and its generated title policy become the stable Gateway-owned contract that native clients use instead of parsing session keys?
rationale: The implementation is additive, but accepting a fixed classification vocabulary and title policy creates a long-lived public protocol commitment that code review alone cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve the narrow contract
options.body: Keep the optional non-sensitive projection, document stability and fallback semantics, prove mixed-version behavior, and remove the changelog edit before merge.

options.title: Use a broader descriptor API
options.body: Pause this branch and incorporate presentation into a more general session descriptor contract if additional identity or hierarchy fields are expected soon.

options.title: Keep client-side presentation
options.body: Decline the new Gateway taxonomy and continue exposing existing raw row metadata for clients to interpret independently.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow contract
recommendation.body: Keep the optional non-sensitive projection, document stability and fallback semantics, prove mixed-version behavior, and remove the changelog edit before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice sets Gateway protocol and product ownership rather than requiring a mechanical code repair alone.
